UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Tracks a player's points, shiny treasures, food eaten, and river progress.

displayName.description: Display name of the river explorer.

totalPoints.description: Total points earned from treasures, stars, and foraging.

foodEaten.description: Total larvae, minnows, and berries eaten.

furthestDistance.description: Furthest downstream distance reached in meters.

smoothStones.description: Count of polished smooth stones collected.

lostTrinkets.description: Count of lost river trinkets collected.

shimmeringScales.description: Count of shimmering fish scales collected.

riverPearls.description: Count of glowing river pearls collected.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last progress save.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores private point tracking and treasure inventory for each authenticated player.
